# tel.yandex.by

> > A gateway to Yandex's comprehensive ecosystem of consumer and business services with integrated security verification.

tel.yandex.by serves as a service directory and entry point for the Yandex platform, featuring a complete catalog of applications and tools spanning search, communication, transportation, commerce, and cloud services. The site includes SmartCaptcha security verification to protect against automated access.

## Service Directory & Ecosystem

- [All Yandex Services](https://tel.yandex.by/all): Complete directory of Yandex services including Alisa voice assistant, Video, Images, Browser, Maps, Market, Mail, Disk, Travel, Weather, Go transportation, Eats delivery, Auto.ru, and cloud solutions

## Security & Verification

- [SmartCaptcha Verification](https://tel.yandex.by/): Bot detection and security verification system by Yandex to protect services from automated access and ensure user authenticity
